plugin.name: Translation_Mode
plugin.author: Mush-Z translation prototype
plugin.purpose: Asynchronous contextual translation bridge for Mush-Z

muclient.script:
local function tm_debug(msg) end
PLUGIN_ID = "c7b37d98c8e34df68f4e50a1" MUSHREADER_ID = "925cdd0331023d9f0b8f05a7" enabled = false review_mode = false pending = {} pending_ticks = 0 pending_target_ticks = 3 seq = 0 requests = {} recovery_requested = false base = (GetInfo(67):gsub("[/\\]+$", ""):match("^(.*)[/\\][^/\\]+$") or GetInfo(67)) .. "/plugins/translation_bridge" inbox = base .. "/inbox" outbox = base .. "/outbox" worker = base .. "/translation_worker.py" logfile = GetInfo(67) .. "/translation_plugin.log" configfile = base .. "/translation_config.json" update_status_file = base .. "/translation_update_status.txt" debug_logging = false accessible_history_mode = "all" update_notice_spoken = false
local unicode_history = {} local unicode_history_pos = 0 local unicode_history_limit = 1000 local unicode_history_seq = 0 local history_follow_tail = true local block_starts = { ["You know the following skills:"] = "skills", ["You are carrying:"] = "inventory", ["The following items are available for sale at this time:"] = "shop_items", ["The following spell castings may be purchased for a small fee:"] = "shop_spells", ["The following items are currently up for grabs:"] = "free_items" } local active_block = nil local pending_categories = {} local block_diag = {starts=0,skills=0,inventory=0,carried_container=0,ground_container=0,shop_items=0,shop_spells=0,free_items=0,history=0}
local function block_category_for_line(line) local exact = block_starts[line] if exact then return exact end if line:find("carried contains:", 1, true) then return "carried_container" end if line:find("on ground contains:", 1, true) then return "ground_container" end return nil end
local function load_debug_setting() local f = io.open(configfile, "rb") if not f then return false end local text = f:read("*a") or "" f:close() return text:match('"debug_logging"%s*:%s*true') ~= nil end
local function load_accessible_history_mode() local f = io.open(configfile, "rb") if not f then return "all" end local text = f:read("*a") or "" f:close() local mode = text:match('"accessible_history_mode"%s*:%s*"([^"]+)"') if mode == "off" or mode == "skills" or mode == "all" then return mode end return "all" end
local function cloud_api_candidate_status() local paths = {base .. "/translate_api.txt", base .. "/translate api.txt"} for _, path in ipairs(paths) do local f = io.open(path, "rb") if f then local text = f:read("*a") or "" f:close() text = text:gsub("^\239\187\191", "") local value = nil local count = 0 for line in text:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do line = line:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if line ~= "" and not line:find("^#") then count = count + 1 local label, candidate = line:match("^([%w_]+)%s*=%s*(.-)%s*$") if label then label = label:upper() if label ~= "GOOGLE_CLOUD_API_KEY" and label ~= "API_KEY" then return "invalid", path end value = candidate else value = line end end end if count == 1 and value and #value >= 20 and #value <= 200 and not value:find("[^%w_%-]") then return "candidate", path end return "invalid", path end end return "missing", nil end
local function log(msg, critical) if not debug_logging and not critical then return end local f = io.open(logfile, "ab") if f then f:write(os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") .. " [PLUGIN] " .. tostring(msg) .. "\r\n") f:close() end end local function clean(s) s = tostring(s or "") s = s:gsub("\r", " "):gsub("\n", " ") return s end local speech_seq = 0 local session_id = string.format("%010d_%010d", os.time(), math.floor(os.clock() * 1000000) % 10000000000) local session_file = base .. "\\mush_session_" .. session_id .. ".alive" local review_state_file = (os.getenv("TEMP") or base) .. "\\mushz_translation_review_mode.txt" local review_entry_file = (os.getenv("TEMP") or base) .. "\\mushz_translation_review_entry.txt" local function touch_session_file() local f = io.open(session_file, "wb") if f then f:write(tostring(os.time())); f:close() end end local function remove_session_file() os.remove(session_file) end local function set_review_mode_state(active) review_mode = active and true or false if not review_mode then os.remove(review_state_file) os.remove(review_entry_file) os.remove(review_entry_file .. ".tmp") return end local tmp = review_state_file .. ".tmp" local f = io.open(tmp, "wb") if not f then return end f:write(session_file .. "\r\n") f:close() os.remove(review_state_file) os.rename(tmp, review_state_file) end local function write_review_entry(entry) if not review_mode then return end local text = type(entry) == "table" and entry.text or entry if type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then return end local tmp = review_entry_file .. ".tmp" local f = io.open(tmp, "wb") if not f then return end f:write(text); f:close() os.remove(review_entry_file) os.rename(tmp, review_entry_file) end local function speak(text, order_id) if not text or text == "" then return end speech_seq = speech_seq + 1 local hex = (text:gsub(".", function(c) return string.format("%02X", string.byte(c)) end)) local world_dir = GetInfo(67) or "" local worlds_dir = world_dir:gsub("[/\\]+$", ""):match("^(.*)[/\\][^/\\]+$") or world_dir local inbox = worlds_dir .. "\\plugins\\translation_bridge\\speech_inbox" local name = order_id or string.format("%s_%06d", session_id, speech_seq) local tmp, final = inbox .. "\\" .. name .. ".tmp", inbox .. "\\" .. name .. ".txt" local f = io.open(tmp, "wb") if not f then return end f:write(hex); f:close(); os.rename(tmp, final) end
local function history_trim() while #unicode_history > unicode_history_limit do table.remove(unicode_history, 1) unicode_history_pos = math.max(0, unicode_history_pos - 1) end end local function history_add(text) if type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then return end local follow = history_follow_tail or #unicode_history == 0 unicode_history_seq = unicode_history_seq + 1 local entry = {id=unicode_history_seq, text=text} unicode_history[#unicode_history + 1] = entry history_trim() if follow then unicode_history_pos = #unicode_history end return entry.id end local function history_insert_before(anchor_id, texts) if type(texts) ~= "table" or #texts == 0 then return end local selected_id = unicode_history[unicode_history_pos] and unicode_history[unicode_history_pos].id or nil local at = nil for i, entry in ipairs(unicode_history) do if entry.id == anchor_id then at = i; break end end if not at then for _, text in ipairs(texts) do history_add(text) end return end for offset, text in ipairs(texts) do unicode_history_seq = unicode_history_seq + 1 table.insert(unicode_history, at + offset - 1, {id=unicode_history_seq, text=text}) end history_trim() if selected_id then for i, entry in ipairs(unicode_history) do if entry.id == selected_id then unicode_history_pos = i; return end end end unicode_history_pos = #unicode_history end local function history_speak(entry) local text = type(entry) == "table" and entry.text or entry if text and text ~= "" then write_review_entry(entry) speak(text) end end local function history_review(entry) if entry then write_review_entry(entry) end end function TranslationHistoryPrevious() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos = math.max(1, unicode_history_pos - 1); history_follow_tail = false; history_speak(unicode_history[unicode_history_pos]) end function TranslationHistoryNext() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos = math.min(#unicode_history, unicode_history_pos + 1); history_follow_tail = unicode_history_pos == #unicode_history; history_speak(unicode_history[unicode_history_pos]) end function TranslationHistoryTop() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos=1; history_follow_tail = false; history_speak(unicode_history[1]) end function TranslationHistoryBottom() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos=#unicode_history; history_follow_tail = true; history_speak(unicode_history[unicode_history_pos]) end function TranslationHistoryPreviousReview() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos = math.max(1, unicode_history_pos - 1); history_follow_tail = false; history_review(unicode_history[unicode_history_pos]) end function TranslationHistoryNextReview() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos = math.min(#unicode_history, unicode_history_pos + 1); history_follow_tail = unicode_history_pos == #unicode_history; history_review(unicode_history[unicode_history_pos]) end function TranslationHistoryTopReview() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos=1; history_follow_tail = false; history_review(unicode_history[1]) end function TranslationHistoryBottomReview() if #unicode_history == 0 then speak("No translation history."); return end unicode_history_pos=#unicode_history; history_follow_tail = true; history_review(unicode_history[unicode_history_pos]) end function SpeakBlockDiagnostic() speak("block diagnostic. starts "..block_diag.starts..", skills "..block_diag.skills..", inventory "..block_diag.inventory.. ", carried "..block_diag.carried_container..", ground "..block_diag.ground_container..", shop items "..block_diag.shop_items.. ", shop spells "..block_diag.shop_spells..", free items "..block_diag.free_items..", history "..block_diag.history.. ", active "..tostring(active_block or "none")) end
local function b64(data) local chars='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/' return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) local r,bits='',x:byte() for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(bits%2^i-bits%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end return r end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x) if #x < 6 then return '' end local c=0 for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end return chars:sub(c+1,c+1) end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1]) end
function ClearRecentTranslationCache() if not enabled then speak("Translation mode is off.") return end seq = seq + 1 local request_id = string.format("%s_%06d", session_id, seq) local command = "__MUSHZ_CONTROL_CLEAR_RECENT_CACHE__:5" local tmp = inbox .. "/req_" .. request_id .. ".tmp" local final = inbox .. "/req_" .. request_id .. ".txt" local f = io.open(tmp, "wb") if not f then speak("Unable to request cache cleanup.") return end f:write(b64(command)); f:close() if not os.rename(tmp, final) then os.remove(tmp) speak("Unable to request cache cleanup.") return end requests[request_id] = {original="Cache cleanup failed.", ticks=0, categories={}, skip_history=true} end
local function file_exists(path) local f = io.open(path, "rb") if f then f:close(); return true end return false end
local function start_update_check() os.remove(update_status_file) local script = base .. "\\check_translation_update.ps1" local version = base .. "\\translation_version.json" local windir = os.getenv("WINDIR") or "C:\\Windows" local powershell = windir .. "\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe" if not file_exists(script) or not file_exists(version) or not file_exists(powershell) then return false end local params = '-NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "' .. script .. '" -VersionFile "' .. version .. '" -StatusFile "' .. update_status_file .. '"' local ok, err = utils.shellexecute(powershell, params, base, "open", 0) if not ok then log("update check launch failed=" .. tostring(err)) end return ok and true or false end
local function poll_update_notice() if update_notice_spoken then return end local f = io.open(update_status_file, "rb") if not f then return end local text = f:read("*a") or "" f:close() local status = text:match("status=([^\r\n]+)") if status == "update" then local version = text:match("version=([^\r\n]+)") or "new" update_notice_spoken = true utils.msgbox( "發現翻譯更新版本 " .. version .. "。\r\n\r\n" .. "請先關閉 MUSHclient，再執行 worlds\\plugins\\translation_bridge\\update_translation.cmd。", "翻譯更新", "ok", "!", 1 ) elseif status == "current" or status == "error" then update_notice_spoken = true end end
local function start_worker() if not file_exists(worker) then log("ERROR worker file not found=" .. tostring(worker), true) return false end
local pythonw = base .. "/runtime/python/pythonw.exe" if not file_exists(pythonw) then local localapp = os.getenv("LOCALAPPDATA") or "" local candidates = { localapp .. "\\Programs\\Python\\Python310\\pythonw.exe", localapp .. "\\Programs\\Python\\Python311\\pythonw.exe", localapp .. "\\Programs\\Python\\Python312\\pythonw.exe", localapp .. "\\Programs\\Python\\Python313\\pythonw.exe" } for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do if file_exists(candidate) then pythonw = candidate; break end end end if not file_exists(pythonw) then log("ERROR portable or installed pythonw.exe not found", true) return false end
local ok, err = utils.shellexecute(pythonw, '"' .. worker .. '" "' .. session_file .. '"', base, "open", 0) if not ok then log("ERROR hidden worker launch failed=" .. tostring(err), true) end return ok and true or false end local speech_worker_started = false local function start_speech_worker() if speech_worker_started then return true end local world_dir = GetInfo(67) or "" local worlds_dir = world_dir:gsub("[/\\]+$", ""):match("^(.*)[/\\][^/\\]+$") or world_dir local script = worlds_dir .. "\\plugins\\translation_bridge\\nvda_speech_worker.ps1" local windir = os.getenv("WINDIR") or "C:\\Windows" local powershell = windir .. "\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe" if not file_exists(script) or not file_exists(powershell) then return false end local params = '-NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "' .. script .. '"' local ok, err = utils.shellexecute(powershell, params, base, "open", 0) if not ok then log("ERROR hidden speech worker launch failed=" .. tostring(err), true) return false end speech_worker_started = true return true end
function OnPluginTick() touch_session_file() end
function OnPluginInstall() set_review_mode_state(false) touch_session_file() debug_logging = load_debug_setting() accessible_history_mode = load_accessible_history_mode() start_update_check() log("Translation Mode 0.8.1 THREE MODE REVIEW installed", true) log("base=" .. tostring(base)) log("worker=" .. tostring(worker)) Accelerator("ctrl+shift+t", "translation_toggle") Accelerator("ctrl+shift+pageup", "translation_history_previous") Accelerator("ctrl+shift+pagedown", "translation_history_next") Accelerator("ctrl+shift+home", "translation_history_top") Accelerator("ctrl+shift+end", "translation_history_bottom") -- Private silent history commands used by the NVDA app module. Direct -- Ctrl+Shift history hotkeys retain their original spoken behavior. Accelerator("ctrl+alt+shift+pageup", "translation_history_previous_review") Accelerator("ctrl+alt+shift+pagedown", "translation_history_next_review") Accelerator("ctrl+alt+shift+home", "translation_history_top_review") Accelerator("ctrl+alt+shift+end", "translation_history_bottom_review") Accelerator("ctrl+shift+f8", "translation_block_diagnostic") Accelerator("ctrl+shift+delete", "translation_cache_clear_recent") tm_debug("TM DEBUG INSTALL: Translation Mode 0.6.0 loaded") end
function ToggleTranslation() tm_debug("TM DEBUG 1: toggle entered")
if not enabled then accessible_history_mode = load_accessible_history_mode() local api_status = cloud_api_candidate_status() if api_status == "candidate" then Execute("tts_note Google Cloud API candidate found.") elseif api_status == "invalid" then log("Google Cloud API candidate file is invalid; using prototype fallback", true) Execute("tts_note Google Cloud API file invalid. Using standard translation.") end if not start_speech_worker() then log("ERROR speech worker launcher not found or failed", true) Execute("tts_note Translation speech worker failed to start. Translation remains off.") return end -- Starting is idempotent: the worker lock rejects a duplicate process and -- recovers immediately when its previous owner crashed. do local ok, result = pcall(start_worker) if not ok then tm_debug("TM DEBUG ERROR: start_worker Lua error: " .. tostring(result)) log("ERROR start_worker Lua error=" .. tostring(result), true) Execute("tts_note Translation worker failed to start. Translation remains off.") return end if not result then Execute("tts_note Translation worker failed to start. Translation remains off.") return end end enabled = true -- Enabling always enters Chinese-screen review mode. The NVDA app module -- redirects numpad review to bilingual Translation Mode history. set_review_mode_state(true) if #unicode_history > 0 then write_review_entry(unicode_history[unicode_history_pos]) end pending = {}; pending_ticks = 0; pending_target_ticks = 3 log("toggle enabled=true review_mode=true") Execute("tts_stop") Execute("tts_note Chinese review mode on.") else -- The only other state is off. Keep the old standard/English-screen -- translation mode out of the user-facing cycle. enabled = false set_review_mode_state(false) log("toggle enabled=false") pending = {}; pending_ticks = 0; pending_target_ticks = 3 for request_id,r in pairs(requests) do if r.original then speak(r.original, request_id) end end requests = {} Execute("tts_stop") Execute("tts_note Translation mode off.") end end
local exit_words = { n=true, s=true, e=true, w=true, u=true, d=true, ne=true, nw=true, se=true, sw=true, north=true, south=true, east=true, west=true, up=true, down=true, northeast=true, northwest=true, southeast=true, southwest=true, none=true }
local function strip_exit_heading(text) local patterns = { {"^exits%s*:%s*", "exit"}, {"^exit%s*:%s*", "exit"}, {"^doors%s*:%s*", "door"}, {"^door%s*:%s*", "door"}, {"^doors%s+", "door"}, {"^door%s+", "door"} } for _, item in ipairs(patterns) do local stripped, count = text:gsub(item[1], "", 1) if count > 0 then return stripped, item[2] end end return text, nil end
local function is_exit_line(line) local text = clean(line):lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local heading text, heading = strip_exit_heading(text) if text == "" then return false end -- A labelled exit/door may have a world-specific name such as portal, -- hatch or trail. Preserve it immediately instead of asking the model to -- guess or silently omit it. if heading then return true end local count = 0 for word in text:gmatch("%S+") do word = word:gsub("^[%[%(%{]+", ""):gsub("[%]%)%},%.]+$", "") if not exit_words[word] then return false end count = count + 1 end return count > 0 end
local exit_labels = { n="北", s="南", e="東", w="西", u="上", d="下", ne="東北", nw="西北", se="東南", sw="西南", north="北", south="南", east="東", west="西", up="上", down="下", northeast="東北", northwest="西北", southeast="東南", southwest="西南", none="無" }
local function exit_history_text(line) local original = clean(line):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local value = original:lower() local heading = "出口：" local heading_kind value, heading_kind = strip_exit_heading(value) if heading_kind == "door" then heading = "門：" end local chinese_parts = {} local english_parts = {} for word in value:gmatch("%S+") do local key = word:gsub("^[%[%(%{]+", ""):gsub("[%]%)%},%.]+$", "") chinese_parts[#chinese_parts + 1] = exit_labels[key] or "特殊出口" english_parts[#english_parts + 1] = key end return heading .. table.concat(chinese_parts, "，") .. "，" .. table.concat(english_parts, "，") end
local flush_pending
local function queue_buffered(line, target_ticks) if not enabled then return "0" end line = clean(line) if line:find("^%s*$") then return "0" end -- Navigation remains under Mush-Z's existing English speech behavior. if is_exit_line(line) then local request_id = nil if #pending > 0 and flush_pending then request_id = flush_pending() end local anchor_id = history_add(exit_history_text(line)) if request_id and requests[request_id] then requests[request_id].history_anchor_id = anchor_id end return "0" end local category = block_category_for_line(line) if category then active_block = category block_diag.starts = block_diag.starts + 1 block_diag[category] = (block_diag[category] or 0) + 1 end table.insert(pending, line) table.insert(pending_categories, active_block or false) pending_ticks = 0 pending_target_ticks = math.min(pending_target_ticks or 3, target_ticks) return "1" end
-- Called synchronously by MushReader. Never do network/model work here. function QueueLine(line) return queue_buffered(line, 3) end
-- Plugin-generated Note() output gets a short 100 ms buffer. function QueueNote(line) return queue_buffered(line, 1) end
flush_pending = function() if #pending == 0 then return nil end seq = seq + 1 local request_id = string.format("%s_%06d", session_id, seq) local original = table.concat(pending, "\n") log("flush request=" .. tostring(seq) .. " lines=" .. tostring(#pending) .. " chars=" .. tostring(#original)) local tmp = inbox .. "/req_" .. request_id .. ".tmp" local final = inbox .. "/req_" .. request_id .. ".txt" local f = io.open(tmp, "wb") if not f then log("ERROR cannot open inbox tmp=" .. tmp, true) speak(original, request_id); pending = {}; pending_ticks = 0; pending_target_ticks = 3; return nil end f:write(b64(original)); f:close() local ok = os.rename(tmp, final) if not ok then os.remove(tmp); speak(original, request_id) else requests[request_id] = {original=original, ticks=0, categories=pending_categories} log("request written=" .. final) end pending = {}; pending_categories = {}; pending_ticks = 0; pending_target_ticks = 3; active_block = nil return request_id end
-- tts_interrupt output is already classified as urgent by the originating -- Mush-Z plugin. Flush it immediately without waiting for TranslationTick. function QueueUrgent(line) if not enabled then return "0" end line = clean(line) if line:find("^%s*$") then return "0" end if is_exit_line(line) then history_add(exit_history_text(line)); return "0" end if #pending > 0 then flush_pending() end table.insert(pending, line) flush_pending() return "1" end
local skill_ratings = { "very bad", "very good", "exceptional", "moderate", "average", "perfect", "poor", "fair", "good", "bad" }
local function is_skill_line(line) local text = clean(line):lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") for _, rating in ipairs(skill_ratings) do local pattern = rating:gsub(" ", "%%s+") local name = text:match("^(.-)%s+" .. pattern .. "%s+%d+%%%s*$") if name and name:find("%S") then return true end end return false end
local function split_lines(text) text = tostring(text or ""):gsub("\r\n", "\n"):gsub("\r", "\n") local lines = {} for line in (text .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do lines[#lines + 1] = line end return lines end
local function to_hex(text) return (text:gsub(".", function(c) return string.format("%02X", string.byte(c)) end)) end
local function translated_sentence_parts(text) local value = tostring(text or ""):gsub("\r\n", " "):gsub("[\r\n]", " ") local parts, start = {}, 1 local delimiters = {"。", "！", "？", "!", "?"} while start <= #value do local nearest_start, nearest_end = nil, nil for _, delimiter in ipairs(delimiters) do local a, b = value:find(delimiter, start, true) if a and (not nearest_start or a < nearest_start) then nearest_start, nearest_end = a, b end end if not nearest_start then break end local finish = nearest_end while finish < #value do local next_byte = value:sub(finish + 1, finish + 1) if next_byte == '"' or next_byte == "'" then finish = finish + 1 else break end end local part = value:sub(start, finish):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if part ~= "" then parts[#parts + 1] = part end start = finish + 1 end local tail = value:sub(start):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if tail ~= "" then parts[#parts + 1] = tail end return parts end
local function independent_source_events(lines) local output = {} for _, line in ipairs(lines) do local value = line:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if value ~= "" then if not value:match("[%.%!%?][\"']?%s*$") then return nil end output[#output + 1] = value end end if #output < 2 then return nil end return output end
local function trailing_independent_row_start(lines) local function complete(line) local value = tostring(line or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") return #value >= 12 and value:match("[%.%!%?][\"'%)%]]*$") ~= nil end if #lines < 2 then return nil end local start = #lines + 1 for i = #lines, 2, -1 do if not complete(lines[i]) or not complete(lines[i - 1]) then break end start = i end if start <= #lines then return start end return nil end
-- Quest descriptions are display-wrapped by the game, while the worker -- deliberately joins each prose section before translating it. Rebuild the -- same semantic rows here so NVDA history can retain one bilingual entry per -- label or paragraph instead of collapsing the entire quest into one entry. local function quest_semantic_source_lines(lines) local output, field = {}, {} local function flush_field() if #field == 0 then return end output[#output + 1] = table.concat(field, " ") field = {} end local function is_quest_label(value) return value:match("^Quest Name:%s*") or value:match("^Location:%s*") or value:match("^Area Level:%s*") or value:match("^Creator:%s*") or value:match("^Editors:%s*") or value:match("^Approximate difficulty %(scale from 1 to 10%):%s*") or value:match("^General Quest Info:%s*") or value:match("^Previous goal short description:%s*") or value:match("^Previous goal long description:%s*") or value:match("^Current goal short description:%s*") or value:match("^Current goal long description:%s*") end if not tostring(lines[1] or ""):match("^%s*Quest Name:%s*") then return nil end for _, line in ipairs(lines) do local value = tostring(line or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if value ~= "" then if is_quest_label(value) then flush_field() field[1] = value else field[#field + 1] = value end end end flush_field() return output end
-- Cloud providers may return several physical Chinese lines for one quest -- field even though the source field is one semantic paragraph. Group the -- translated text by its deterministic Chinese field labels before pairing -- it with quest_semantic_source_lines. Without this, a harmless line-count -- difference makes the history layer collapse the entire quest into one row. local function quest_semantic_translated_lines(lines) local output, field = {}, {} local function flush_field() if #field == 0 then return end output[#output + 1] = table.concat(field, " ") field = {} end local function is_quest_label(value) return value:match("^任務名稱：") or value:match("^魔法任務名稱：") or value:match("^地點：") or value:match("^區域等級：") or value:match("^作者：") or value:match("^編輯者：") or value:match("^大約難度（1 到 10）：") or value:match("^任務概述：") or value:match("^一般任務資訊：") or value:match("^一般任務信息：") or value:match("^之前目標簡述：") or value:match("^之前目標詳細說明：") or value:match("^之前的任務簡述：") or value:match("^之前的任務詳細描述：") or value:match("^之前的支線任務簡述：") or value:match("^之前的支線任務詳細描述：") or value:match("^目前目標簡述：") or value:match("^目前目標詳細說明：") or value:match("^目前的目標簡述：") or value:match("^當前目標簡短描述：") or value:match("^當前目標詳細描述：") or value:match("^當前目標長描述：") end if not tostring(lines[1] or ""):match("^%s*任務名稱：") then return nil end for _, line in ipairs(lines) do local value = tostring(line or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if value ~= "" then if is_quest_label(value) then flush_field() field[1] = value else field[#field + 1] = value end end end flush_field() return output end
-- Dialogue is often display-wrapped to a different number of physical lines -- than its translation. Keep the complete quoted utterance together before -- any generic line-count or trailing-row pairing can split it. local function is_quoted_dialogue(value) local text = tostring(value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local starts = text:match("^[^\r\n]- says,%s*['\"]") ~= nil or text:match("^[^\r\n]- asks,%s*['\"]") ~= nil or text:match("^[^\r\n]- tells? [^\r\n]-,%s*['\"]") ~= nil return starts and (text:match("['\"]%s*$") ~= nil) end
local function collect_accessible_history(original, translated) local entries = {} if is_quoted_dialogue(original) then local zh = tostring(translated or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local en = tostring(original or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if zh ~= "" and en ~= "" then entries[1] = zh .. " | " .. en end return entries end local source_lines = split_lines(original) local translated_text = tostring(translated or "") -- Some older cached translations contain a valid quest label immediately -- after prose on the same physical line. Recover that semantic boundary -- before grouping, so old cache and cloud output follow the same layout. local quest_labels_zh = { "任務名稱：", "魔法任務名稱：", "地點：", "區域等級：", "作者：", "編輯者：", "大約難度（1 到 10）：", "任務概述：", "一般任務資訊：", "一般任務信息：", "之前目標簡述：", "之前目標詳細說明：", "之前的任務簡述：", "之前的任務詳細描述：", "之前的支線任務簡述：", "之前的支線任務詳細描述：", "目前目標簡述：", "目前目標詳細說明：", "目前的目標簡述：", "當前目標簡短描述：", "當前目標詳細描述：", "當前目標長描述：" } if tostring(original or ""):match("^%s*Quest Name:%s*") then for _, label in ipairs(quest_labels_zh) do translated_text = translated_text:gsub("([^\r\n])(" .. label .. ")", "%1\n%2") end end local translated_lines = split_lines(translated_text) local quest_source = quest_semantic_source_lines(source_lines) if quest_source then local quest_translated = quest_semantic_translated_lines(translated_lines) if quest_translated and #quest_source == #quest_translated then for i, en in ipairs(quest_source) do entries[#entries + 1] = quest_translated[i] .. " | " .. en end return entries end end if #source_lines ~= #translated_lines then -- The worker deliberately renders display-wrapped room prose as one entry -- and each trailing NPC/object as its own line. Pair those trailing rows -- from the end so NVDA review does not merge them back into the room. local row_start = trailing_independent_row_start(source_lines) local row_count = row_start and (#source_lines - row_start + 1) or 0 if row_start and #translated_lines == row_count + 1 then local narrative = {} for i = 1, row_start - 1 do local value = source_lines[i]:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if value ~= "" then narrative[#narrative + 1] = value end end local zh = translated_lines[1]:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if zh ~= "" and #narrative > 0 then -- Preserve source display boundaries until the presentation expander -- has separated the room title. The expander then flattens English. entries[#entries + 1] = zh .. " | " .. table.concat(narrative, "\n") end for offset = 0, row_count - 1 do local en = source_lines[row_start + offset]:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local row_zh = translated_lines[2 + offset]:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if en ~= "" and row_zh ~= "" then entries[#entries + 1] = row_zh .. " | " .. en end end return entries end -- Split only when every source line is a complete event and the translated -- sentence count agrees exactly. Display-wrapped room prose stays grouped. local source_events = independent_source_events(source_lines) local translated_events = source_events and translated_sentence_parts(translated) or nil if source_events and #source_events == #translated_events then for i, en in ipairs(source_events) do entries[#entries + 1] = translated_events[i] .. " | " .. en end return entries end local zh = tostring(translated or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local en = tostring(original or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if zh ~= "" and en ~= "" then entries[#entries + 1] = zh .. " | " .. en end return entries end for i, source in ipairs(source_lines) do local zh = translated_lines[i]:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local en = source:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if zh ~= "" and en ~= "" and not en:match("^%-+$") then entries[#entries + 1] = zh .. " | " .. en end end return entries end
-- Expand every bilingual entry into real history rows. This is -- presentation-only: translation output and cache stay untouched. Rows are -- always stored top-to-bottom as one-line English followed by Chinese. This -- gives numpad 7/9 one consistent path for single sentences, rooms and dialog. local function expand_accessible_history_entries(entries) local output = {} for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do local zh, en = tostring(entry or ""):match("^(.-)%s+|%s+([%s%S]*)$") if not zh or not en then output[#output + 1] = entry else local dialogue = is_quoted_dialogue(en) if dialogue then local english_line = en:gsub("[\r\n]+", " "):gsub("%s+", " ") :gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local chinese_line = zh:gsub("[\r\n]+", " "):gsub("%s+", " ") :gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if english_line ~= "" then output[#output + 1] = english_line end if chinese_line ~= "" then output[#output + 1] = chinese_line end else local parts = translated_sentence_parts(zh) local wrapped = en:find("[\r\n]") ~= nil if wrapped then local first_en = en:match("^%s*([^\r\n]+)") or "" first_en = first_en:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local first_zh = parts[1] or "" local space_start, space_end = first_zh:find("%s+") if #first_en > 0 and #first_en <= 80 and not first_en:match("[%.%!%?%:%;]$") and space_start and space_start > 1 and space_start <= 120 then local title = first_zh:sub(1, space_start - 1):gsub("%s+$", "") local remainder = first_zh:sub(space_end + 1):gsub("^%s+", "") if title ~= "" and remainder ~= "" then table.remove(parts, 1) table.insert(parts, 1, remainder) table.insert(parts, 1, title) end end end local english_line = en:gsub("[\r\n]+", " "):gsub("%s+", " ") :gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if english_line ~= "" then output[#output + 1] = english_line end for _, part in ipairs(parts) do local line = part:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if line ~= "" then output[#output + 1] = line end end end end end return output end
local function write_accessible_history(original, translated, categories, anchor_id) if accessible_history_mode == "off" then return end local entries = collect_accessible_history(original, translated) -- Quest output is already split deterministically into semantic rows. Store -- every English field above the matching set of Chinese fields. Class skill -- tables deliberately continue through the ordinary expander below so each -- English skill row stays immediately above its matching Chinese row. local source_text = tostring(original or "") local grouped_rows = source_text:match("^%s*Quest Name:%s*") if grouped_rows then local english_entries, chinese_entries = {}, {} for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do local zh, en = tostring(entry or ""):match("^(.-)%s+|%s+([%s%S]*)$") zh = tostring(zh or ""):gsub("[\r\n]+", " "):gsub("%s+", " ") :gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") en = tostring(en or ""):gsub("[\r\n]+", " "):gsub("%s+", " ") :gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if en ~= "" then english_entries[#english_entries + 1] = en end if zh ~= "" then chinese_entries[#chinese_entries + 1] = zh end end entries = {} for _, en in ipairs(english_entries) do entries[#entries + 1] = en end for _, zh in ipairs(chinese_entries) do entries[#entries + 1] = zh end else entries = expand_accessible_history_entries(entries) end if anchor_id then history_insert_before(anchor_id, entries) else for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do history_add(entry) end end block_diag.history = block_diag.history + #entries end
local function write_fallback_history(req) if not req or not req.original or req.skip_history or accessible_history_mode == "off" then return end local entry = "English fallback: " .. tostring(req.original) if req.history_anchor_id then history_insert_before(req.history_anchor_id, {entry}) else history_add(entry) end block_diag.history = block_diag.history + 1 end
local function poll_results() -- Poll each outstanding request independently. A lost result must not block -- every later translation. for request_id, req in pairs(requests) do local path = outbox .. "/res_" .. request_id .. ".txt" local f = io.open(path, "rb") if f then
tm_debug("TM RESULT 2: Lua found response " .. tostring(request_id)) local text = f:read("*a") or "" f:close() tm_debug("TM RESULT 3A: response bytes=" .. tostring(#text) .. " prefix=" .. tostring(text:sub(1,12):gsub("\r","<CR>"):gsub("\n","<LF>"))) os.remove(path)
requests[request_id] = nil
if enabled then local translated = nil if text:sub(1,4) == "OK\r\n" then translated = text:sub(5) elseif text:sub(1,3) == "OK\n" then translated = text:sub(4) end if translated then tm_debug("TM RESULT 3B: response OK; translated chars/bytes=" .. tostring(#translated)) tm_debug("TM RESULT 4: calling speak()") if req and req.original and not req.skip_history then local history_ok, history_err = pcall(write_accessible_history, req.original, translated, req.categories, req.history_anchor_id) if not history_ok then log("ERROR accessible history Lua failure=" .. tostring(history_err), true) end end local ok, err = pcall(speak, translated, request_id) if ok then tm_debug("TM RESULT 5: speak() returned") else tm_debug("TM RESULT ERROR: speak() failed: " .. tostring(err)) log("ERROR speech queue write failed request=" .. tostring(request_id) .. " error=" .. tostring(err), true) if req and req.original then speak(req.original, request_id) end end else tm_debug("TM RESULT ERROR: response is not OK; falling back to English") log("ERROR malformed or failed translation response request=" .. tostring(request_id), true) if req and req.original then pcall(write_fallback_history, req) speak(req.original, request_id) end end else tm_debug("TM RESULT: response arrived while translation mode disabled") end end end end local function expire_requests() for n,r in pairs(requests) do r.ticks = (r.ticks or 0) + 1 -- 35 seconds at a 100 ms timer. Worker has its own 25-second timeout and returns ERR for English fallback. if r.ticks >= 350 then log("TIMEOUT request=" .. tostring(n), true) if enabled and r.original then pcall(write_fallback_history, r); speak(r.original, n) end requests[n] = nil -- Keep process launch out of the 100 ms TranslationTick. recovery_requested = true end end end
function TranslationTick() touch_session_file() if enabled and #pending > 0 then pending_ticks = pending_ticks + 1 -- Narrative uses 300 ms; plugin Notes use a short 100 ms buffer. if pending_ticks >= pending_target_ticks then flush_pending() end end poll_results() expire_requests() end
function TranslationRecoveryTick() poll_update_notice() if not recovery_requested then return end recovery_requested = false local ok, result = pcall(start_worker) if not ok or not result then log("ERROR worker recovery launch failed=" .. tostring(result), true) end end
function OnPluginClose() set_review_mode_state(false) remove_session_file() end
